title: Remove and refit the stock fork legs
completeness: Complete removal/refit of intact stock fork legs, including wheel, caliper and alignment closure. No fork opening, damping adjustment or bearing replacement.
entry_state: Assembled standard US 2021 FC450 F2475U2 with stock fork, clamps, wheel and front brake.
Fork assemblies intact and serviceable; hydraulic circuit remains closed.
exit_state: Both fork legs and front wheel refitted at stock height; caliper/line secured and fork aligned.
Brake contact restored; parking stand removed before riding.

source.review_note: Independently read exact2021 OEM title and operations; visually checked PDF3,55,59,60,111,112,113. Standard model spacer route, not Rockstar disc-guard route. No later-year inheritance.

required_tools.name: Stable motorcycle lift and plug-in parking stand
Suitable hand tools and torque wrench

required_parts.name: Long-life grease
required_parts.purpose: Wheel seals, spacer contact faces and spindle

preflight: Open the linked diagrams to identify axle and clamp screws.
Do not sit on the elevated bike or operate the brake lever with the wheel removed.
critical_stop_conditions: Unstable support or damaged fork/clamp/brake hardware.
Worn or damaged wheel bearings require a separate replacement operation.
Brake contact does not return, line is strained, or alignment cannot be completed.

steps.title: Support the bike
steps.instruction: Remove the parking stand; lift under the frame on firm, level ground. Secure against tipping with both wheels clear.
steps.verification: Bike stable; nobody on the supported bike.
steps.origin: OEM owner manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Remove the front wheel
steps.instruction: Push the caliper toward the disc, avoiding spokes. Back axle screw out several turns; loosen axle clamps. Push screw to release spindle, then remove screw. Support wheel, withdraw spindle and remove wheel/spacers.
steps.verification: Protect the disc. Do not operate the brake lever while the wheel is out.
steps.origin: OEM owner manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Remove both legs
steps.instruction: Remove brake-line clamp and caliper bolts. Keep the connected caliper/line loosely aside. Support each leg while loosening its upper/lower clamps; withdraw both legs.
steps.verification: Hydraulic circuit remains closed and line unstressed; note left/right positions.
steps.origin: OEM owner manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Restore stock fork position
steps.instruction: Install left air leg and right damping leg. Left air valve and right bleeder face forward. Align the second groove from the top with the upper clamp top edge.
steps.verification: Record both second-groove positions and forward-facing controls.
steps.origin: OEM owner manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Secure fork clamps
steps.instruction: Tighten upper M8 clamp bolts to 17 Nm, then lower M8 bolts to 12 Nm.
steps.verification: Record upper and lower torques; stock position retained.
steps.origin: OEM owner manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Refit front brake hardware
steps.instruction: Fit caliper: M8 bolts 25 Nm with Loctite 243. Restore brake line and its clamp; tighten clamp screws.
steps.verification: Record caliper torque/threadlocker; line retained without strain.
steps.origin: OEM owner manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Inspect and prepare wheel
steps.instruction: Inspect bearings for wear/damage; replace faulty bearings before continuing. Clean and grease shaft seals, spacer contact faces and spindle with long-life grease. Refit spacers.
steps.verification: Keep grease off disc; clean contamination with brake cleaner.
steps.origin: OEM owner manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Install wheel and axle
steps.instruction: Position wheel with pads correctly around disc. Insert spindle; tighten M20×1.5 axle screw to 35 Nm.
steps.verification: Record axle torque. Shoe clamps remain loose for alignment.
steps.origin: OEM owner manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Restore brake contact and align
steps.instruction: Pump lever until pads contact disc. Lower bike. Hold front brake and firmly compress forks several times; then tighten M8 shoe clamps to 15 Nm.
steps.verification: Record alignment before shoe-clamp torque. Brake operates normally.
steps.origin: OEM owner manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Check closure
steps.instruction: Check the refitted fork and brake-line positions against the source diagrams. Park using the plug-in stand; remove it before riding.
steps.verification: Both wheels fitted; all removed fasteners secured, brake contact restored and alignment completed.
steps.origin: OEM owner manual; original factual companion
